theses.title: Menaphos soul altar adds soul rune supply
theses.trigger: True Soul Altar in Menaphos, letting players craft soul runes at 90 Runecraft
theses.release: Spring 2027 (roadmap; Menaphos passed the RuneFest 2026 summit poll)
theses.evidence: Upcoming updates list, OSRS Wiki: Menaphos includes the true Soul Altar, allowing soul rune crafting at 90 Runecraft. https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Upcoming_updates
theses.mechanism: A new crafting route adds soul rune supply, pushing price down unless demand from soul talisman and tiara crafting absorbs it.
theses.substitutes: Existing soul rune sources continue; Menaphos adds supply rather than replacing them.
theses.action_detail: No position until the Menaphos release date is confirmed. If holding into release week, sell into any early price spike.
theses.exit_plan: Sell holdings during release-week strength, before new altar supply ramps up.
theses.what_would_kill_it: Soul talisman or tiara demand absorbs the extra runes, or quest gating keeps early supply tiny.

theses.title: Diamond Dragon boss arrival boosts arrow demand
theses.trigger: Diamond Dragon boss in the Dungeons of Gielinor update, placed in a Varlamore dungeon with Gemstone Dragons
theses.release: Spring 2027 (Dungeons of Gielinor passed the RuneFest 2026 summit poll)
theses.evidence: Upcoming updates list, OSRS Wiki: the Diamond Dragon sits in a new Varlamore dungeon with Gemstone Dragons. https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Upcoming_updates. Gemstone dragons have an Arrows weakness: https://www.runehq.com/monster/dragonstone-dragon
theses.mechanism: Gemstone dragons are weak to arrows, so a new Gemstone boss raises demand for arrows used in those fights.
theses.substitutes: Rune, amethyst and ruby arrows, plus ranged bolts, all compete for the same ranged-user demand.
theses.action_detail: Monitor Dungeons of Gielinor release timing and the Diamond Dragon's drop table. Only act once the arrow weakness and drops are confirmed.
theses.exit_plan: If buying, sell after the first major content wave, when arrow demand cools.
theses.what_would_kill_it: Many substitute arrows absorb the demand, or the boss is only lightly used by ranged players.
